figures.title: Generated traffic used by every controller
figures.caption: Illustrative seed 1760. Ten matched seeds per scenario; virtual five-second windows. These are synthetic aggregate flow demands.

figures.title: Held-out delay across eight traffic scenarios
figures.caption: 86,400 windows = 8 scenarios × 10 held-out seeds × 120 windows × 9 controllers. O1 is a privileged myopic model reference.

figures.title: Adaptive memory compared with previous guarded memory
figures.caption: A4 minus A3. Negative favors A4. 95% paired seed bootstrap intervals, 4,000 draws; exploratory with no multiplicity correction.

figures.title: The memory ablation after the same base guard
figures.caption: A4 minus H1. Negative favors A4. 95% paired seed bootstrap intervals, 4,000 draws; exploratory with no multiplicity correction.

figures.title: Delay must be judged together with loss and goodput
figures.caption: Equal weights across the eight primary scenarios and ten paired seeds. A4 overlaps H1; their estimates are identical in this suite.

figures.title: Distributions over the measured simulation windows
figures.caption: These are distributions of modeled window means, not packet-delay distributions. A4 and H1 curves overlap.

figures.title: Action feasibility and installed behavior
figures.caption: All controllers share the independent action validator. A4 had zero rejected proposals; this does not by itself prove a performance improvement.

figures.title: Queue occupancy around the alternate-path traffic shift
figures.caption: One illustrative trace, seed 1760. The dashed line marks the demand shift; it is not an aggregate estimator.

figures.title: Measured control computation in the isolated virtual environment
figures.caption: Includes the control computation, observation and measurement; excludes final batched memory persistence. Timing depends on this computer.

figures.title: Actual Gemini control latency after the pipeline changes
figures.caption: Two fresh seeds, 24 cycles per mode. Full-cycle timing includes reflection and pacing. Smaller call counts do not prove a faster provider server.

figures.title: Provider work and local reuse are counted separately
figures.caption: Cache, bypass, memory reuse and provider failures are never labeled as new successful API decisions. Local reflection makes no provider request.

figures.title: Measured full-cycle latency by simulated traffic window
figures.caption: Mode order reverses on the second seed. Timing includes all decision and reflection work; the dashed line is the five-second target.

figures.title: Compact free-model checks: 8/17 valid responses
figures.caption: One healthy-network schema check for every discovered zero-price :free model. Availability is not a congestion-control quality benchmark.

figures.title: Targeted memory diagnostic near the capacity boundary
figures.caption: Post-hoc constructed stress test, separate from the primary average. Ten seeds per level; all cold-start windows retained. Higher reward trades delay against goodput and loss.

figures.title: Memory adapts after observed harmful throttling
figures.caption: Constructed excess = 0.0001 Mbps diagnostic. A4 learns from earlier action outcomes; the plotted privileged O1 reference has simulator access.
